title: US stocks today: US stocks retreat as oil crosses $100, yields rise ahead of inflation data
summary: US stocks fell on Wednesday as Brent crude climbed above $100 a barrel, raising fresh inflation concerns and weighing on investor sentiment. The S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow declined as Treasury yields rose ahead of key US inflation data. Markets are also weighing the possibility of a Federal Reserve rate hike next week.

title: Barclays raises S&P 500 year-end target to 7,950 on strong earnings
summary: Barclays raised its year-end S&P 500 target to 7,950 from 7,800, citing strong corporate earnings and continued AI investment. The brokerage expects earnings momentum to persist despite inflation, geopolitical risks and interest-rate concerns. Other major banks are also bullish, with several forecasting the index to finish the year above 8,000.
